svg.title: Common marmoset
svg.desc: Seated common marmoset with mottled gray-brown fur, white ear tufts, grasping hands and feet, and a banded tail. Biological basis: Common marmosets are small New World primates used in neuroscience, aging, reproduction, and infectious-disease research under specialized ethical oversight.
